_daz3_note: DAZ3 is a CONFIRMED FALSE POSITIVE (corrected 2026-06-02). ~158-164 +strand reads at DAZ3 are secondary alignments of DAZ1 (median NM ~6 at DAZ1 vs ~88 at DAZ3); only ~2-6 reads genuinely prefer DAZ3. The committed anchored-prior + joint-strand EM correctly ABSTAINS (cov ~4, low_confidence, identifiability none). This is a MAX guard (was daz3_isoforms_min:5, the phantom target): it fails if DAZ3 over-enumerates, i.e. if the phantom 5-isoform/cov-113 recovery regresses back (reproducible only with RUSTLE_VG_JOINT_STRAND_EM=0 RUSTLE_VG_ANCHOR_PRIOR=0).
_obj5_note: O4/O5 copy-resolution guards (the discriminating metric is copy ATTRIBUTION, not chain Sn/Pr — baseline has no copy concept). obj5_copy_attr_min: at an identifiable merged bundle (id 0.97, DEFAULT settings) VG must attribute ambiguous multimappers to their true source copy at >=1.0 (the Tier-2 capability). obj5_id1_max_decisive_frac: at IDENTICAL copies (id 1.0, the DAZ limit) VG must ABSTAIN — 0 decisive calls — so this caps decisive_frac at 0.0 (no fabrication). Both only assert when the EM actually ran. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-03-o4o5-copy-resolution-benchmark.md.
